subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Which durable contract should own subagent lifecycle receipts and audited supervision actions: the metadata-only audit ledger, the task/subagent ledgers, or a dedicated subagent lifecycle API?
rationale: Current main has enough adjacent task, audit, and subagent state for several designs, but exposing artifact pointers, failure signatures, and cancel/steer/resume controls requires maintainer intent for persistence, retention, authorization, redaction, and public API shape.

options.title: Extend shared audit foundation
options.body: Use the metadata-only audit ledger as the canonical durable source, then add subagent-specific receipt and supervision views on top.

options.title: Create subagent lifecycle ledger
options.body: Add a dedicated lifecycle table and API for subagent receipts, accepting a narrower but potentially parallel audit source.

options.title: Keep summaries only
options.body: Decline durable subagent lifecycle receipts for now and continue with task/subagent summaries plus internal controls.

recommendation.title: Extend shared audit foundation
recommendation.body: Use the metadata-only audit ledger as the canonical durable source, then add subagent-specific receipt and supervision views on top.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing signal for subagent control and adjacent metadata-audit product direction.
